name: @ebanux/inventory-contract
description: Versioned, framework-neutral wire contract for A-Tap inventory APIs.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm pack --dry-run
